newsitem.title: USA: C-TEC units to resell NYNEX phone service.
newsitem.headline: C-TEC units to resell NYNEX phone service.

text.p: C-TEC Corp said Monday that its subsidiary, RCN Inc, has become the first company to resell NYNEX Corp's local telephone service to New York City residents.
On October 8, NYNEX began being required to resell local telephone service to other communications providers under new U.S. Federal Communications Commission rules designed to encourage competition.
The resale agreement will allow RCN to offer telephone service to customers who currently do not have access to RCN's network. RCN currently has about 2,200 local customers.
